snippet.title: Steam Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
Early glimpse at Crypts Of Carith.

Crypts is a first person, Party-based, blobber with turn based combat, heavily inspired by the likes of The Bards Tale (Original trilogy) and Wizardry.
